title: DeFiLlama
description: Integration with DeFi Llama API providing comprehensive decentralized finance data including token prices, protocol TVL, DEX volumes, and stablecoin metrics

defillama_fetch_first_price.title: Fetch First Price
defillama_fetch_first_price.description: Retrieves inaugural trading price data for assets with historical context

defillama_fetch_fees_overview.title: Fetch Fees Overview
defillama_fetch_fees_overview.description: Provides aggregated fee statistics across DEXs, lending protocols, and other fee-generating DeFi primitives

defillama_fetch_stablecoin_chains.title: Fetch Stablecoin Chains
defillama_fetch_stablecoin_chains.description: Shows blockchain distribution of stablecoin supply with chain-specific circulation metrics

defillama_fetch_stablecoin_charts.title: Fetch Stablecoin Charts
defillama_fetch_stablecoin_charts.description: Generates historical charts for stablecoin market cap, supply changes, and chain dominance

defillama_fetch_chain_historical_tvl.title: Fetch Chain Historical TVL
defillama_fetch_chain_historical_tvl.description: Retrieves historical TVL data for specific blockchain chains with daily granularity

defillama_fetch_total_historical_tvl.title: Fetch Historical TVL
defillama_fetch_total_historical_tvl.description: Provides historical TVL trends for the entire DeFi ecosystem or specific protocol categories

defillama_fetch_protocols.title: Fetch Protocols
defillama_fetch_protocols.description: Retrieves comprehensive list of all tracked DeFi protocols with their category, chain, and TVL data

defillama_fetch_dex_overview.title: Fetch DEX Overview
defillama_fetch_dex_overview.description: Provides aggregated DEX metrics including total volume, top trading pairs, and liquidity distribution
